parole.significato: A steroid sapogenin, obtained from certain yams, that has estrogenic activity.
parole.testo: From translingual Dios(corea) + genin, after German Diosgenin.

parole.significato: Any of the plants of the genus Funkia (now Hosta).
parole.testo: From the genus name, translingual Funkia, from German Funck, after botanist H. C. Funck.

parole.significato: An infectious disease of some insects caused by some microsporidian parasites of the genus Nosema.
parole.testo: 1909, translingual Nosema (“a taxonomic genus within the family Nosematidae”) + disease; a calque of German Nosemaseuche, coined from Nosema + Seuche (“epidemic, pestilence”).
